sentences.text: 2. Status report by way of affidavit of Gurmukh Singh, SDPO (Central) on behalf of the respondent-UT Chandigarh has been filed in the Court today which is taken on record subject to all just exceptions.
A copy of the same has been handed over to the counsel opposite.

1 of 2 Neutral Citation No:=2023:PHHC:107208 2023:PHHC:107208 CRM-M-27345-2023 (O&M)
-2- 3.

Learned State counsel, on instructions from SI Suresh Kumar, has apprised the Court that report has been received from the CFSL, Gujarat wherein a definite opinion has been given that the letter purportedly written by the deceased to the Estate Office, Chandigarh was a forged document.

Learned State counsel submits that in the circumstances, since a definite opinion has been received,
the investigating agency would be proceeding in accordance with law.
4.
In view of the above, no further order is required to be passed in the present petition which is disposed of accordingly.
